items.claim: Uncontrolled `mixed` NumberField loses what was typed
items.note: With this React Aria version the typed value is kept, but the field does switch from uncontrolled to controlled and back, and React Aria warns "changed from controlled to uncontrolled". The field now keeps its own value when uncontrolled, so React Aria always sees a controlled field.

items.claim: Held stepper keeps its timer through a disable and steps by itself once re-enabled
items.note: `spent` is now true while the field refuses input, so the hold ends on its own.

items.claim: Wheel blocks page scroll on a focused field that cannot step
items.note: At a bound `spin` still returned true, so the wheel now checks `spent` as well as what `spin` returns.

items.claim: `spin` compares its step against the live value, not where typing began
An offset after an `onInput` preview uses the preview and never sends the starting value back
items.note: The offset now adds to `typing.from`. With `onOffset`, `onInput(from)` is sent first. A commit that lands back where typing began also sends `onInput(from)`. I updated the `onInput` doc to match.
